summary: Links an actor name to a response name by appending an 8-byte mapping node to the mapping list headed at a1+0x224. Looks the actor up in the UTF-16 string linked list (global dword_8B8F2C) and the response up in a binary tree, resolves or creates the actor-response mapping node, then appends it to the tail of the list. On any lookup failure logs a formatted error and returns -1.

Inspect the mapping list head at a1+0x224: if it is non-null, walk to the tail by following next pointers (head node +0x4).
